company.shortDescription: Hydrexa is a climate technology company.
company.description: Hydrexa is a climate technology company focused on addressing water scarcity and sustainable cooling through advanced engineering and material science. The company develops atmospheric water harvesting and dehumidification technologies that extract water vapor from the air to generate clean drinking water while also improving cooling efficiency and reducing energy consumption.

productsAndServices.description: Systems that extract water vapor from the atmosphere to produce purified drinking water for various scales, from residential to industrial use.
productsAndServices.name: Atmospheric Water Generation Systems

productsAndServices.description: Air conditioning and dehumidification systems that use less energy and harvest atmospheric moisture to provide cooling and humidity control.
